native.payload_bytes: Actual complete application data octets unknown nonnegative integer, may exceed65535 and span TCP segments. TCP MSS/MTU/send or read buffer boundaries are not application message limits.
native.ctcp_specification_source: Required actual custom TCP application specification reference unknown. RFC9293 specifies TCP service, not this application framing.
native.ctcp_specification_revision: Required actual application specification revision unknown; no invented1.0 baseline.
native.ctcp_transport_binding: Required actual TCP/IP/link binding reference unknown. Cannot infer Ethernet10M/1G, IPv4/IPv6, peer MSS/options/checksum/timers from custom application registration.
native.ctcp_stream_service: RFC9293 section2.2 reliable ordered byte stream standard proposal. Actual transport state/correlation required; no application message boundary or execution acknowledgement guarantee.
native.ctcp_framing: Required actual FIXED_LENGTH/LENGTH_PREFIX/DELIMITER/CONNECTION_CLOSE/CUSTOM framing unknown. TCPPSH/segment/readbuffer not accepted framing modes, RFC9293 section3.7.
native.ctcp_layout_source: Actual application fields/encoding/framing layout reference unknown. Native TCP header/ACK/options belong to lower TCP profile, not copied into application format.
native.ctcp_header_bytes: Actual encoded application header octets unknown nonnegative integer; excludes lower TCP/IP headers, includes prefix when located here.
native.ctcp_trailer_bytes: Actual encoded application trailer octets unknown nonnegative integer; includes delimiter/checksum if specified. No general CRC2/header8 default.
native.ctcp_escape_expansion_bytes: Actual encoded escaping expansion unknown nonnegative integer; escaping algorithm/collision-safe delimiter needs actual specification.
native.ctcp_message_bytes: Actual complete encoded application message exact known payload+header+trailer+escape expansion; <=actual peer message limit. Not a single TCP segment or MSS-capped chunk.
native.ctcp_peer_message_limit_bytes: Actual peer full application message capability unknown nonnegative integer; can exceed65535, not inferred from16-bit TCP MSS or interface MTU.
native.ctcp_fixed_length_bytes: Actual fixed full application message length positive integer unknown; only FIXED_LENGTH, equal known actual complete message.
native.ctcp_length_prefix_bytes: Actual positive application prefix width unknown; only LENGTH_PREFIX. No u16/four-byte universal prefix assumption.
native.ctcp_length_prefix_scope: Actual PAYLOAD/COMPLETE_MESSAGE/CUSTOM length counting unknown. Prefix overflow/signedness/coverage depend actual application revision.
native.ctcp_length_prefix_order: Actual LITTLE_ENDIAN/BIG_ENDIAN/CUSTOM prefix encoding unknown; TCP network byte order does not dictate application encoding.
native.ctcp_delimiter_hex: Actual nonempty whole-octet hex delimiter unknown, only DELIMITER. Odd hex invalid. No newline/CRLF default or byte-stream guarantee that delimiter cannot occur in data.
native.ctcp_escaping_source: Actual application delimiter escaping rule reference unknown; wire expansion and incremental read correlation remain required.
native.ctcp_security_profile: Actual TLS/authentication/application security profile reference unknown; TCP checksums do not authenticate. No TLS or NONE default.
native.ctcp_application_ack: Actual application acknowledgement semantics unknown boolean. TCP peer transport acknowledgement does not confirm application receipt/execution. Known false rejects application ACK timeout.
native.ctcp_application_ack_timeout_ms: Actual positive finite application acknowledgement timeout unknown milliseconds; zero invalid. Separate from TCP RFC6298 retransmission timer, no generic100ms/1s copying.
native.ctcp_device_evidence: Actual peer buffering/implementation/timing evidence reference unknown; default service description is not actual capability or capacity proof.

removed.qos_priority: No implicit IEEE Ethernet PCP/CAN priority for an unspecified custom TCP application application protocol; actual lower transport owns priority.
removed.sync_method: No implicit NTP/PTP/gPTP support in a custom custom TCP application protocol; actual timing/synchronization requires its own specification.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal custom TCP application-protocol bandwidth reservation; actual underlying link/schedule evidence required.
removed.retransmission_enabled: No universal custom custom TCP application acknowledgement/ARQ default. Actual lower transport and application retry rules must be distinguished.
removed.retransmission_rate: A generic probability is not a custom TCP application acknowledgement/retry state machine.
removed.retry_limit: No zero retry-count protocol default without a specified application/lower-transport retry mechanism.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal zero retry delay for unspecified custom TCP application framing/session semantics.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No verified custom TCP application gateway throughput of100Mbit/s; actual device unknown.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: Actual gateway input capability unknown, not custom TCP application protocol default8.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: Actual gateway output capability unknown, not custom TCP application protocol default8.
removed.gateway_maximum_routes: Actual gateway route capability unknown, not custom TCP application protocol default4096.
removed.gateway_maximum_messages_s: Actual gateway processing capability unknown, not custom TCP application protocol default100000.
removed.bitrate: Retire inherited Ethernet10M rate; custom TCP application has no physical bitrate. Explicit actual TCP/IP/link profiles own rate.
removed.mtu_bytes: Retire default EthernetMTU1500, distinct from actual path MTU, TCP MSS and full application message.
removed.duplex: Retire Ethernet FULL/HALF physical-port default. Bidirectional TCP byte stream does not prove actual link duplex.
removed.vlan_id: Retire VLAN0 automatic actual configuration; custom TCP application defines no IEEE802.1QVID.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Retire default Ethernet shaper0; actual TCP congestion/window control and lower link shaper are separate.

revisions: RFC9293 August2022 sections2.2/3.7/3.7.1/3.8; RFC6298 June2011 transport timer distinct from application ACK
scope: Every registered customTCP application field and retired Ethernet/retry assumptions; byte-stream framing, actual peer message cap, acknowledgement separation and isolated SQL retention.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters
